items.title: Addiction and Tolerance of Nicotine (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Addiction and Tolerance of Nicotine: a main subheading of 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 48-48.

blocks.text: Nicotine tambakoo ki cheezon (cigarettes, cigars aur baghair dhuein wala tambakoo) mein maujood bohat nasha-awar stimulant (jagane wala madda) hai. Yeh dimagh ke nicotine receptors se jurti hai. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh receptors dopamine aur doosre neurotransmitters chhorte hain jo lutf ka ehsas dete hain.

Nicotine ka baqaida istemal tolerance paida karta hai, is liye wahi lutf ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye hoti hai. Jab nicotine achanak band ki jaye to chirchirapan, ghabrahat (anxiety) aur shadeed talab (cravings) jaisi withdrawal symptoms hoti hain. Nicotine ka lamba istemal sehat ke kai nuqsanat se bhi jura hai, jin mein cancer, dil ki bimari aur saans ke masail ka barha hua khatra shamil hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Dopamine ki wapsi rokna cocaine ka tareeqa hai; doosri nasha-awar drugs doosre tareeqon se dopamine barhati hain (maslan opioids endorphin receptors ke zariye), is liye kitab ka tareeqa saada kiya hua hai. Kitab yeh bhi likhti hai ke nicotine receptors 'dopamine chhorte hain'; dar asal yeh receptors rakhne wale neurons jag kar dopamine chhorte hain.

blocks.prompt: Roz coffee peene wale ko coffee ke baghair din sar dard kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Musalsal caffeine se tolerance ban chuki hai; caffeine achanak band hone par sar dard aur thakan jaisi withdrawal symptoms aati hain.

items: Dependence (drug par inhisar), addiction (be-qaboo talab), tolerance (wahi asar ke liye zyada khuraak), withdrawal (chhorne par alamaat).

Dopamine cleft mein jama, postsynaptic receptors kam (tolerance), drug band karne par neuron kam jagta (withdrawal). Caffeine adenosine rokta hai; nicotine nicotine receptors se jur kar dopamine barhati hai.
